allot.text: We hereby inform that the Board of Directors of the Company has, at its meeting held today i.e. on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at  The Capital ,  A  Wing, 6th Floor, No. 603- 606, Plot No. C-70,  G  Block, Bandra-Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai   400051, inter alia:1.
